confirmed_protocol_issues: The adapter omitted decoder presence when treating conditional dense logits as category probabilities.
Meta SAM3 paper F.1 evaluates semantic segmentation by filtering/composing per-category instance masks using presence, mask confidence and areas; our dense argmax is a project adaptation.
Changing adapter.prompts on an existing object without clearing its text cache would reuse old embeddings; this did not occur in the completed fixed-prompt run or the direct-encoding diagnostics.
interpretation: Old 5004-image numbers are valid measurements of the legacy custom adapter, not a valid official SAM3 semantic baseline. Presence alone did not fix crater recognition on this small diagnostic subset. Prompt variants are not full-test improvement claims.
limits: 18 fixed images, 6 per scene; not representative enough to rank new recipes.
Instance diagnostic uses the official processor default score threshold 0.5 and binary union, not the full semantic-benchmark composition.
No new learning or speed optimization was performed.
